purpose: Supplementary source-discovered challenges added during the rewrite; reported separately from the frozen 32-question development set, without a before/after improvement claim.

questions.query: If a tick reports failure after hitting capacity, is it safe to retry as though nothing changed?
facts: No transactional rollback guarantee exists for World::tick failure.
Tick/epoch advancement and queued explosion effects can occur before later preparation/capacity failure, leaving partial progress.
Web pauses on failure, while desktop ignores the return; a common retry/recovery contract remains unresolved.

questions.query: Will frozen offscreen sand resume automatically when the camera moves back, including the serial reference backend?
facts: Phased native region filtering can exclude active blocks while quiet/sleep accounting continues, so excluded blocks can sleep.
Changing or clearing the simulation region does not wake those sleeping blocks; they may need a separate external wake to resume.
SerialInPlace does not apply the same region filter. Intended re-entry behavior requires an explicit implementation decision and regression coverage.
